config.GT_policy: seal all64 outputs and receipts before independent CPU labels
config.Source: unadapted cached Source boxes and native224 final-layer physical MBR
config.decision: Source is overall baseline; Global6 and GlobalPermuted6 identify temporal feedback; Strong is reference only. If real fusion has no advantage, stop this feedback direction; no mixture sweep.
config.fixed_space: same historical A BoxFixed trajectory for all temporal intervals
config.global: mean of six separately normalized physical interval posteriors; never mean logits
config.head: original TA-STVG MLP from the same Source checkpoint, model_ema preferred exactly as original loader
config.head_batch: full six-layer hidden per offset; final-layer logits, posterior and MBR must recover saved outputs bitwise
config.permuted: same readout on saved fixed-permuted-tube hidden
config.reliability: unchanged old correspondence reliability; not event probability
config.space: unchanged original BoxFixed geometry, score, interval view and exact DP
config.tube: same readout on saved real-tube hidden; no new decoder replay

costs.deployment_reference: C previous measured native224 capture plus aux DP/two offset decoder replay/final DP; six-layer probability averaging is new lightweight postprocessing, not measured complete deployment here.
costs.scope: Head-only cached validation. Input IO, original frozen head projection, posterior construction, three final BoxFixed DPs and engineering recovery checks are measured. Historical native224/expert/decoder work is not counted as new computation. Do not report this as deployment time.
